content.title: Top Traffic Actions
content.query:
// Traffic Action Breakdown
let TotalEvents =
    toscalar(
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
        | where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
        | count
    );
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend Action = extract(@"[^ ]+$", 0, replace_string(Activity, "traffic:", ""))
| summarize Events=count() by Action
| extend PercentageValue = round((todouble(Events) * 100.0) / TotalEvents, 2)
| extend ActionLabel = strcat(Action)
| project ActionLabel, PercentageValue
| order by PercentageValue desc

content.title: Top Denied IPs
content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| where Activity contains "deny"
| extend Country = extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| summarize DeniedCount=count() by SourceIP, Country
| top 10 by DeniedCount desc
| join kind=leftouter (
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Confidence) by ObservableValue
) on $left.SourceIP == $right.ObservableValue
| extend Confidence = todouble(Confidence)
| extend Confidence = coalesce(Confidence, 0.0)
| extend Status = iff(Confidence > 50.0, "Malicious", "Not Malicious")
| project SourceIP, Country, DeniedCount, Confidence, Status
| order by DeniedCount desc

content.title: Top Source Countries
content.query:
let CountryGeo =
_GetWatchlist('CountryGeo')
| project Country=SearchKey,
          Latitude=todouble(latitude),
          Longitude=todouble(longitude);
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct == "Fortigate"
| extend Country = extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| where Country != "Reserved"
| summarize Events=count() by Country
| lookup kind=leftouter CountryGeo on Country
| where isnotempty(Latitude)
| project 
    Latitude, 
    Longitude, 
    Events, 
    Country
| take 10
| order by Events desc

content.title: Top Policies

// Top Policies

content.title: Top Bandwidth Consumers
content.query:
// Top Bandwidth Consumers (GB) with Device Name and Source Country
let DeviceMap =
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where isnotempty(LocalIP)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceName) by SourceIP=LocalIP
| project SourceIP, DeviceName;
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend SourceCountry=extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| extend SourceCountry=iff(isempty(SourceCountry) or SourceCountry == "Reserved", "Internal / Reserved", SourceCountry)
| summarize SentGB=round(sum(SentBytes)/1024.0/1024.0/1024.0,3),
          ReceivedGB=round(sum(ReceivedBytes)/1024.0/1024.0/1024.0,3),
          TotalGB=round((sum(SentBytes)+sum(ReceivedBytes))/1024.0/1024.0/1024.0,3)
    by SourceIP, SourceCountry
| join kind=leftouter DeviceMap on SourceIP
| extend DeviceName=iff(isempty(DeviceName), "Unknown / External", DeviceName)
| top 10 by TotalGB desc
| project 
    SourceIP, 
    DeviceName,
    SourceCountry, 
    SentGB, 
    ReceivedGB, 
    TotalGB
| order by TotalGB desc

content.title: Top Denied Source Countries
content.query:
// Top Denied Source Countries
let CountryGeo =
_GetWatchlist('CountryGeo')
| project Country=SearchKey,
          Latitude=todouble(latitude),
          Longitude=todouble(longitude);
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct == "Fortigate"
| where Activity contains "deny" or DeviceAction contains "deny"
| extend Country = extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| where Country != "Reserved"
| summarize DeniedEvents=count() by Country
| lookup kind=leftouter CountryGeo on Country
| where isnotempty(Latitude)
| where isnotempty(Longitude)
| order by DeniedEvents desc
| take 10
| project Latitude,
          Longitude,
          DeniedEvents,
          Country

// Live Traffic Flow
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| extend ActionRaw = extract(@"FTNTFGTaction=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| extend Action = case(
    Activity contains "deny","🔴 Deny",
    Activity contains "accept","🟢 Allow",
    Activity contains "close","🔵 Close",
    Activity contains "server-rst","🟡 Server Reset",
    Activity contains "client-rst","🟠 Client Reset",
    Activity contains "signature","🟣 Signature",
    "⚪ Other"
)
| extend SourceCountry = extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| extend DestinationCountry = extract(@"FTNTFGTdstcountry=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| extend PolicyName = extract(@"FTNTFGTpolicyname=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
//| extend PolicyID = extract(@"FTNTFGTpolicyid=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| extend SentGB = round(todouble(SentBytes)/1024.0/1024.0/1024.0,3)
| extend ReceivedGB = round(todouble(ReceivedBytes)/1024.0/1024.0/1024.0,3)
| extend TotalTrafficGB = round((todouble(SentBytes)+todouble(ReceivedBytes))/1024.0/1024.0/1024.0,3)
| project 
    TimeGenerated,
    Action,
   // LogSeverity,
   // PolicyID,
    PolicyName,
    SrcIP=SourceIP,
    SrcPort=SourcePort,
    SrcCountry=SourceCountry,
    DstIP=DestinationIP,
    DstPort=DestinationPort,
    DstCountry=DestinationCountry,
    AppProtocol=ApplicationProtocol,
    Message,
    SentGB,
    ReceivedGB,
    TotalTrafficGB
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: UTM Activity Trend (MB)
content.query:
//UTM Activity Trend (MB)
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| where DeviceEventCategory startswith "utm:"
| extend UTMModule = case(
    DeviceEventCategory == "utm:app-ctrl", "Application Control",
    DeviceEventCategory == "utm:webfilter", "Web Filter",
    DeviceEventCategory == "utm:dns", "DNS Filter",
    DeviceEventCategory == "utm:ssl", "SSL Inspection",
    DeviceEventCategory == "utm:ips", "IPS",
    DeviceEventCategory == "utm:virus", "Antivirus",
    "Other UTM Modules"
)
| extend EstimatedBytes = strlen(tostring(pack_all()))
| summarize
    LogCount = count(),
    ApproxMB = round(sum(EstimatedBytes) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 3)
by UTMModule
| order by ApproxMB desc

content.title: Log Volume Distribution
content.query:
// Log Volume Distribution
let TotalEstimatedBytes =
toscalar(
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
    | extend EstimatedBytes = strlen(tostring(pack_all()))
    | summarize sum(EstimatedBytes)
);
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| extend Category = tostring(split(Activity, ":")[0])
| extend EstimatedBytes = strlen(tostring(pack_all()))
| summarize
    EstimatedDataGB = round(sum(EstimatedBytes) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2),
    CategoryBytes = sum(EstimatedBytes)
by Category
| extend PercentageValue = round((todouble(CategoryBytes) * 100.0) / TotalEstimatedBytes, 2)
| project Category, PercentageValue, EstimatedDataGB
| order by PercentageValue desc

content.title: Attack Signature Breakdown
content.query:
//IPS Attack Signature Breakdown
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Fortigate"
| where DeviceEventCategory == "utm:ips"
| extend ThreatSignature = extract(@"FTNTFGTattack=([^;]+)",1,AdditionalExtensions)
| where isnotempty(ThreatSignature)
| extend ThreatCategory =
    case(
        ThreatSignature contains "SQL", "SQL Injection",
        ThreatSignature contains "XSS", "Cross-Site Scripting",
        ThreatSignature contains "Botnet", "Botnet",
        ThreatSignature contains "Command", "Command Injection",
        ThreatSignature contains "Traversal", "Path Traversal",
        ThreatSignature contains "Remote.Code.Execution" or ThreatSignature contains "RCE", "RCE",
        ThreatSignature contains "Unauthorized.Access", "Unauthorized Access",
        ThreatSignature contains "Information.Disclosure", "Information Disclosure",
        ThreatSignature contains "HTPasswd", "Credential Exposure",
        ThreatSignature contains "Exploit", "Exploit Attempt",
        "Other"
    )
| summarize Events=count() by ThreatCategory
| order by Events desc
